name: Anika Sharma
title: My everyday diamond studs
review: I bought the Twinkling Stars studs for myself after eyeing them for months, and they are even prettier in person. The diamonds catch the light beautifully and the gold finish is rich without being loud. They are so light that I forget I am wearing them — I have worn them to work every single day since. The certificate and hallmark details came neatly packed in the box. Already planning my next Mia purchase.

name: Rhea Kapoor
title: Perfect anniversary gift
review: My husband surprised me with the Infinite Love mangalsutra on our anniversary and I could not be happier. It is modern and delicate — exactly the kind of mangalsutra I can wear with western outfits too. The diamonds are well set and the chain is sturdy. Packaging felt premium and gift-ready. Knowing it comes from Tanishq gave us complete confidence in the quality.

name: Meera Pillai
title: Elegant and well-finished
review: Ordered the Aurora Arch ring and the Regal Radiance studs together during the festive sale. Both arrived well-packaged and fully insured. The finishing is genuinely impressive and the sizing guide was accurate. I am giving four stars only because delivery took a day longer than shown, but the jewellery itself is flawless. The making-charges offer made it great value.

name: Sanya Gupta
title: Worth every rupee
review: I was nervous about buying diamond jewellery online, but Mia made it easy. The Whimsical Glimmer bracelet looks exactly like the photos and sits comfortably on the wrist. The clasp is secure and the sparkle is lovely in both daylight and evening light. Customer support answered my sizing questions quickly. I would recommend Mia to anyone looking for wearable everyday diamonds.

name: Kavya Reddy
title: Lifetime exchange is a big plus
review: I have been a Mia customer for years and the lifetime exchange policy keeps me coming back. I recently upgraded an older pendant to the Dual Tone Gold & Diamond Pendant and the process at the store was smooth. The new pendant is gorgeous — the two-tone gold makes it look very premium. Great designs, honest pricing and trusted quality.

name: Priya Nair
title: Lovely festive purchase
review: Picked up the Petal Arc ring for Diwali and got so many compliments at family gatherings. The design is delicate but the ring feels solid. Great offer on making charges too.

name: Neha Joshi
title: Minimal and classy
review: The Dainty Spark earrings are perfect for office wear. Lightweight, secure screw backs and a subtle sparkle. Exactly what I was looking for.

name: Ishita Verma
title: Beautiful design
review: Loved the Double Circle necklace — it layers well with my other chains. The chain is slightly thin, but it looks elegant and the diamonds are bright.

name: Aditi Rao
title: Gift for my mother
review: Bought the Shree Ganesh pendant for my mother's birthday. She wears it daily now. The detailing is beautiful and the gold quality is excellent.

name: Tanvi Shah
title: Trusted quality
review: Hallmarked gold, certified diamonds and lovely packaging. Mia never disappoints. The Evil Eye charm bracelet is my new favourite.

name: Riya Patel
title: So pretty!
review: The rose gold studs are adorable and go with everything I own.

name: Divya Menon
title: Fast delivery
review: Arrived in three days, fully insured and beautifully packed.

name: Sneha Kulkarni
title: Great value
review: Good design and the festive offer made it a steal.
